    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {

        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();

        int count = 0;
        int max = 0;
        int start = -1;
        boolean in = false;

        String s = scanner.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {

                if (start != i - 1) {

                start = i;
            }
        }
        if (start != s.length() - 1)

        writer.close();
